_note: 마법사 캐릭터 아트(오너 지적 2026-08-15 「딜러 마법사 검사 같은 모양인데」). 원인은 아트가 **직업이 아니라 역할(Role)로** 골라져 검사·마법사가 같은 그림을 쓰던 것이다. `ranged/`는 5장, `dps_new/`는 0장이라 쓸 수 있는 두 번째 딜러 아트가 없었다. 프레임 규격·셀 배치는 `spec_char_dps.json`을 그대로 따른다 — 다르게 만들면 `align_frames`·`JOB_FRAMES` 계약이 깨진다.

rulesets.c6: Match the REFERENCE IMAGE's ART STYLE EXACTLY but the character is a MAGE, clearly different from the rogue: a deep indigo robe with wide sleeves and a long hem, a wide pointed hat casting shadow over the eyes, a gnarled wooden staff topped with a glowing pale-blue crystal held in one hand, a leather satchel at the hip. No hood, no scarf, no sword. Reproduce the reference's hand-drawn pixel-art style precisely: same dot size, thin dark outlines, soft cel shading, same body proportions (stocky heroic chibi), same palette. THREE-QUARTER FRONT view at eye level, the FULL BODY standing, both feet visible on the ground. Not photorealistic, not 3D-rendered, no smooth gradients. LAYOUT: EXACTLY SIX CELLS TOTAL — a 3-column by 2-row grid (3 across, 2 down). Do not draw seven, eight, or nine cells. Exactly 3 columns and exactly 2 rows with clear empty pure-magenta gaps between the cells. The SAME knight, SAME scale, SAME camera angle in every cell, feet resting on a common baseline. The six poses MUST differ dramatically so motion is obvious when flipped through. Follow each cell's description literally. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE IN THE IMAGE — no captions, no frame numbers, no state names, no letters, no digits, no watermark, no grid lines, no borders. Only the character art on the magenta field. COLOR: full color, matching the reference palette. Background: flat solid pure magenta #FF00FF everywhere, NO SHADOW OF ANY KIND — no drop shadow, no ellipse or blob under the feet, no contact shadow. The magenta must be perfectly flat and uniform right up to the character's outline. No ground, no scenery.

assets.name: char_mage_A
assets.prompt: A 6-cell sprite sheet of ONE mage. Six poses of the same figure, reading left to right then top to bottom: standing at the ready, staff planted, robe settled; then left foot forward mid-stride, hem swinging back; then right foot forward, opposite sleeve swinging; then staff raised high overhead with the crystal flaring, body coiled; then thrusting the staff forward at full extension, sleeve trailing, body committed; then both hands out casting a wide spell, robe billowing outward.

assets.name: char_mage_B
assets.prompt: A 6-cell sprite sheet of ONE mage. Six poses reading left to right then top to bottom: crouched low beginning a short blink-step, robe compressing; then body half-dissolving into drifting motes mid-blink; then reforming in a low landing stance; then recoiling from a hit, head snapped back, staff arm flung wide; then staggering on one knee, staff propping the body up; then collapsed on the ground, hat fallen beside, staff loose.

assets.name: char_mage_C
